q2_gaps: a compound whose MODIFIER is itself multi-word ('waxed paper' packets): decompose-once gives the head genus `packet`, but the instruction set does not say how to expose (or suppress) a two-word modifier — splitting off `waxed` alone re-brackets it as a property of the packet rather than of the paper, while treating 'waxed paper' as a material noun would suppress it entirely

a locative PP stacked on a non-place CONTAINER NP ('in packets in the store'): the stacked-'in' rule is stated only for a second 'in <Place>' on a place NP, and the containment reading is in any case unavailable here because a bare kind may not fill LocatedIn's entity slot
notes: 'the Cauldron Hall store' is handled exactly per the Northgate-spokesman pattern (head noun typed on its own witness, Possession to the named entity, name-internal kind atom), the agentless passive omits Agent and keeps `keep`'s Theme, and the unmarked present correctly yields no status atom. Attaching both locatives to the keeping event is a coherent reading, so no atom is false — only the packets-in-store nesting goes unrecorded.
